# Massive Designer

> Massive's on-brand images, made from a link: put the values in the URL and it returns the finished JPG. No sign-in, no key.

## How to make an image

1. Pick an image. Templates are made to be filled in; the other images are finished designs that can be re-rendered with changes.
2. Build the image link: `https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/<id>.jpg?<param>=<value>&…`
   - Use only that image's params. Leave a param out to keep its default.
   - URL-encode every value (a space is %20).
   - Text: as it should read, up to 300 characters. Select: one of the listed values. Toggle: true or false.
   - Image: a direct https:// link to the image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF or SVG), not a page that shows it. Share pages from Unsplash, Google Drive or Dropbox (`dl=0`) won't work.
   - Optional: `scale=1` for a 1× image (the default is 2×), `download=1` to download it instead of showing it.
3. Build the edit link from the same params: `https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?i=<id>&<param>=<value>&…`. It opens the design in Massive Designer, filled in, to tweak it, drop in a photo and download it.
4. Reply with both links as plain links, not as markdown images. You don't need to open the image link yourself: it renders when the person clicks it.
5. A photo attached to the chat (not a link) can't go in a URL. Give the edit link and tell the person to drop the photo into the image field there.

Example: "A blog banner called 'Hotel Prices Without a Browser' with this photo: https://example.com/hotel.jpg"
- Image: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/blog-banner.jpg?headline=Hotel%20Prices%20Without%20a%20Browser&photo=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fhotel.jpg
- Edit: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?i=blog-banner&headline=Hotel%20Prices%20Without%20a%20Browser&photo=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fhotel.jpg

Search every image: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/images?q=<words> (add &format=json for JSON). One image's details: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/images?id=<id>.

## Templates

### Blog banner (template)

id `blog-banner` · 1376×768 · content · template

The joinmassive.com blog post banner (Sanity's Banner field), 1376×768: a photo with a dark wash from the left, the Massive logo and the headline in red-light. Use Strong wash for a bright photo. The photo recipe is in assets/photo-prompt.txt.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A wide photo; the headline sits over its left side.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "Seltz: A Web Search API for LLMs". The post's title. Two or three lines; about 60 characters reads best.
- `position`: Headline position. One of `middle` (Middle), `bottom` (Bottom); default `middle`.
- `wash`: Wash. One of `standard` (Standard (dark photo)), `strong` (Strong (bright photo)); default `standard`. Use strong for a bright photo, so the headline stays readable.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/blog-banner.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?i=blog-banner
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/blog-banner/thumb.jpg

### Hiring: Photo (template)

id `hiring-photo` · 1080×1350 · hiring · template

The photo-led hiring post: a lifestyle photo, "We’re hiring" over the role on a red brush stroke, a pitch, four icon rows, a handwritten note with an arrow, and the experience and careers link in an ink footer. Per image, set --seam and data-arrow-to on #canvas.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "We’re hiring".
- `role`: Role (on the swipe). Text; default "Writer in Residence". The job title, on the red swipe. Short: it shrinks to fit two lines.
- `details`: Details line. Text; default "Remote · Part or full time". Level, place and hours, separated by " · ".
- `subline`: Pitch. Text; default "Some of the best benefits in corporate history.".
- `icon1`: Row 1 icon. One of `book` (Book), `calendar` (Calendar), `chart` (Chart), `clock` (Clock), `code` (Code), `database` (Database), `dollar` (Dollar), `globe` (Globe), `handshake` (Handshake), `headset` (Headset), `heart` (Heart), `home` (Home), `map-pin` (Map pin), `megaphone` (Megaphone), `pencil` (Pencil), `server` (Server), `shield` (Shield), `shirt` (Shirt), `sparkle` (Sparkle), `sun` (Sun); default `pencil`.
- `benefit1`: Row 1. Text; default "Do whatever you want, as long as the content is awesome".
- `icon2`: Row 2 icon. One of `book` (Book), `calendar` (Calendar), `chart` (Chart), `clock` (Clock), `code` (Code), `database` (Database), `dollar` (Dollar), `globe` (Globe), `handshake` (Handshake), `headset` (Headset), `heart` (Heart), `home` (Home), `map-pin` (Map pin), `megaphone` (Megaphone), `pencil` (Pencil), `server` (Server), `shield` (Shield), `shirt` (Shirt), `sparkle` (Sparkle), `sun` (Sun); default `globe`.
- `benefit2`: Row 2. Text; default "Remote, from anywhere in the world".
- `icon3`: Row 3 icon. One of `book` (Book), `calendar` (Calendar), `chart` (Chart), `clock` (Clock), `code` (Code), `database` (Database), `dollar` (Dollar), `globe` (Globe), `handshake` (Handshake), `headset` (Headset), `heart` (Heart), `home` (Home), `map-pin` (Map pin), `megaphone` (Megaphone), `pencil` (Pencil), `server` (Server), `shield` (Shield), `shirt` (Shirt), `sparkle` (Sparkle), `sun` (Sun); default `clock`.
- `benefit3`: Row 3. Text; default "Work any hours you like".
- `icon4`: Row 4 icon. One of `book` (Book), `calendar` (Calendar), `chart` (Chart), `clock` (Clock), `code` (Code), `database` (Database), `dollar` (Dollar), `globe` (Globe), `handshake` (Handshake), `headset` (Headset), `heart` (Heart), `home` (Home), `map-pin` (Map pin), `megaphone` (Megaphone), `pencil` (Pencil), `server` (Server), `shield` (Shield), `shirt` (Shirt), `sparkle` (Sparkle), `sun` (Sun); default `shirt`.
- `benefit4`: Row 4. Text; default "Dress code: business up top, your choice below".
- `aside`: Handwritten note. Text; default "Pajamas: approved.". The handwritten note; a few words.
- `showAside`: Handwritten note. True or false; default true. Show the handwritten note and its arrow.
- `experience`: Experience. Text; default "2–4 years of writing".
- `cta`: Call to action. Text; default "Apply at joinmassive.com/careers". Where to apply.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/hiring-photo.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?i=hiring-photo
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/hiring-photo/thumb.jpg

### Hiring: Photo, square (template)

id `hiring-photo-square` · 1080×1080 · hiring · template

The square hiring post: "We’re hiring" over the role on a red brush stroke, the details and careers link, the photo pinned right, and a handwritten note with an arrow. Per image, set --seam and data-arrow-to on #canvas.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "We’re hiring".
- `role`: Role (on the swipe). Text; default "Writer in Residence". The job title, on the red swipe. Short: it shrinks to fit two lines.
- `details`: Details line. Text; default "Remote · Part or full time". Level, place and hours, separated by " · ".
- `cta`: Call to action. Text; default "joinmassive.com/careers".
- `aside`: Handwritten note. Text; default "Pajamas: approved.". The handwritten note; a few words.
- `showAside`: Handwritten note. True or false; default true. Show the handwritten note and its arrow.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/hiring-photo-square.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?i=hiring-photo-square
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/hiring-photo-square/thumb.jpg

### Welcome to Massive: Template (Franklin)

id `welcome-template` · 1080×1350 · team · template

A new teammate's character-sheet card over the dimmed Slack desktop, with the welcome line below: the Welcome to Massive video held still in the Milestone card's layout. Fill in a new hire's details and photo.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A portrait of the new teammate.
- `badge`: Badge. Text; default "New hire".
- `name`: Full name. Text; default "Franklin Uche".
- `firstName`: First name. Text; default "Franklin". Used in "Welcome to the team, …!".
- `status`: Status. Text; default "Available".
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Community Lead".
- `country`: Country. Text; default "Nigeria". In English (e.g. Brazil); it picks the flag.
- `hobbies`: Abilities (comma-separated, up to 5). Text; default "Playing football, Playing golf, Gardening". Each one becomes a chip.
- `food`: Fuel (favourite food). Text; default "Medium rare steak and rice".
- `confetti`: Confetti. True or false; default true. Confetti over the card.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/welcome-template.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?i=welcome-template
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/welcome-template/thumb.jpg
